**Classic Beef Lasagna – A Hearty Family Favorite**

> *Serves:* 8–10  
> *Prep time:* ~20 min | *Cook time:* ~45 min | **Total:** ~65 minutes  

---

### Ingredients

| Category          | Item                     | Quantity |
|-------------------|--------------------------|---------|
| **Meat Sauce**   | Olive oil                | 2 tbsp  |
|                   | Ground beef              | 1 lb (450 g) |
|                   | Italian sausage           | ½ lb (225 g) *(optional)* |
|                   | Onion                    | 1 small, diced |
|                   | Garlic cloves             | 3‑4, minced |
|                   | Crushed tomatoes         | 28 oz (800 ml) canned |
|                   | Tomato paste             | 2 Tbsp |
|                   | Water / Beef broth       | ¼ cup (60 mL) |
|                   | Dried oregano            | 1 tsp |
|                   | Dried basil               | 1 tsp |
|                   | Salt & pepper             | To taste |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta cheese           | 15 oz (425 g) |
|                   | Egg                      | 1 (helps bind ricotta) |
|                   | Grated Parmesan cheese   | ¾ cup (75 g) |
|                   | Fresh parsley, chopped   | 2 Tbsp |
| **Lasagna Sheets** | Dry lasagna noodles     | 12 sheets (or use no‑boil sheets per package instructions) |
| **Topping Cheese** | Shredded mozzarella      | 16 oz (450 g) |
|                   | Extra grated Parmesan    | ⅓ cup (35 g) |

*(Feel free to swap ground turkey/veggie meat for a lighter version.)*

---

### Equipment Needed

* Large skillet or sauté pan  
* Medium saucepan (for sauce)  
* Mixing bowl  
* Baking dish (9×13″ works great)  
* Aluminum foil  
* Oven mitts

---

### Instructions

#### 1️⃣ Make the Meat Sauce  
1. Heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onions → cook until translucent (~5 min).  
2. Stir in garlic → 30 sec more.  
3. Push veggies to side, add ground beef + sausage (if using). Cook until browned, breaking up crumbles. Drain excess fat if desired.  
4. Mix in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, water/broth, oregano, basil, salt, pepper. Bring to simmer. Reduce heat low, let thicken gently while you prep other layers—about 25 minutes. Taste & adjust seasoning.

#### 2️⃣ Prepare the Ricotta Mixture  
In a bowl combine:
* Ricotta  
* Egg  
* Half of the parmesan  
* Parsley  
Season lightly with salt & pepper. Set aside.

#### 3️⃣ Assemble the Lasagna  
1. Preheat oven to **375°F (190°C)**.  
2. Spread a thin layer of meat sauce across the bottom of your baking dish.  
3. Lay down first sheet(s) of pasta (no-boil may only require one layer).  
4. Spoon half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles, spreading evenly.  
5. Sprinkle about ⅔ cup shredded mozzarella.  
6. Repeat layering: sauce → noodles → ricotta → mozzarella. Finish with a topmost layer of sauce.  
7. Cover tightly with aluminum foil (to prevent sticking, spray underside of foil with nonstick spray).

#### 4️⃣ Bake  
Bake covered for **40 minutes**. Remove foil, sprinkle remaining mozzarella + extra parmesan on top, then bake uncovered another **10–15 minutes**, until bubbly and golden brown.

#### 5️⃣ Rest & Serve  
Let stand at room temperature for **10–15 minutes** before slicing—it helps set the layers so slices stay intact. Cut into squares, serve hot! Pair with a crisp green salad and crusty bread for a complete meal.

---

### Tips & Variations

| Idea | How It Works |
|------|--------------|
| **Vegetarian** | Replace meats with sautéed spinach, zucchini, mushrooms, and/or lentils. Use vegetable stock instead of beef broth. |
| **Low-carb** | Swap regular noodles for spiralized zucchini ribbons or pre-cooked whole-wheat/noodle alternatives. |
| **Extra Creaminess** | Fold in a splash of heavy cream or swirl in béchamel sauce between layers. |
| **Spicy Kick** | Add red pepper flakes to the sauce or mix in some spicy salami. |
| **Make Ahead** | Assemble as directed, cover, refrigerate overnight, then bake straight from fridge (add an extra 5–10 mins). Great for busy weeknights. |

Enjoy this comforting classic that’s perfect for family dinners, potlucks, or leftovers saved for lunch tomorrow!
